# Mailercloud

Powerful and simple all-in-one email marketing platform providing effective solutions for rapid business growth.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mailercloud/.

## Actions

- **Create List**: Create a new recipient list in Mailercloud for storing and managing contacts.
- **Get Client Plan** (read-only): Retrieve client plan information from Mailercloud.
- **Search Contacts in List** (read-only): Retrieve contacts in a specific list with pagination.
- **Create custom property**: Create a custom property for contacts in Mailercloud.
- **Delete Contact Property**: Delete a custom contact property by ID.
- **Update Contact Property**: Update a custom property of contacts in Mailercloud.
